name: reconcile_branch_drift
description: Merge a moved remote PR branch into the verified candidate branch; agent resolves conflicts if there are any.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the local git checkout holding the verified candidate branch.

branch.description: Branch name to reconcile against its remote counterpart.

remote.description: Remote name the branch has drifted on.

model.description: Model identifier passed to the conflict-resolution agent. Falls back to the agent's default when omitted.

maxResolutionAttempts.description: Max agent attempts to resolve the conflict before it is marked unresolved. Clamped server-side to [1, 5].

maxBudgetUsd.description: USD budget ceiling for the conflict-resolution agent.

mergeState.description: 'merged': the remote's new commits touched none of the candidate's own changed files, trusted without re-verification. 'resolved': a real conflict was resolved by the agent -- the caller must re-verify before publishing. 'conflicted': resolution failed after maxResolutionAttempts; nothing is trusted, the merge is left aborted.

commit.description: HEAD commit SHA of repoPath after a successful merge/resolution; empty string when mergeState is 'conflicted'.

tokenUsed.description: Total LLM tokens consumed across all conflict-resolution attempts; 0 for a clean merge.

costUsd.description: Total USD cost of conflict-resolution attempts; 0 for a clean merge.
